title: N'etiti Ụwa na Eluigwe
intro: Mkpụrụ obi dị omimi na-echere gị n'ime peeji dị nsọ nke akụkọ ihe mere eme Chineke, na-ebu ihe ịrịba ama na ihe ebube ndị ka na-ada ụda kemgbe ọtụtụ afọ. Ka ị na-eso ụzọ ihe ngosi, ị ga-agafe akụkọ e ji ọrụ ebube mara - site na mmalite ọrụ ebube ruo n'ịrịgo gafere eluigwe. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta ohu a dị ngọzi tupu ihe ngosi ikpeazụ?
clues: E zigara m dịka onye ozi nye ụmụ Izrel site n'ikwu maka ebere na ìhè.
Ọmụmụ m bụ ihe ịrịba ama dị ebube — abịara m n'ụwa a na-enweghị nna, site n'iwu nke Onye Pụrụ Ime Ihe Nile.
Ekwuru m okwu mgbe m ka bụ nwa ọhụrụ, na-agbachitere nsọpụrụ nne m megide ebubo ndị obodo ya.
Site n'ikike Chineke, ejiri m ụrọ kpụọ nnụnụ ma kuo ume ndụ n'ime ha - ha fepụrụ n'ihu ndị na-ekiri ha.
Agụrụ m ndị ìsì mụrụ, gwọọ ndị ekpenta, ọbụna kpọlite ​​ndị nwụrụ anwụ — mana ọrụ ebube niile sitere n'aka Chineke, ọ bụghị nke m.
Mgbe ndị iro m zubere ibibi m, Allah kpọlitere m n'eluigwe ma kwe nkwa na m ga-alọghachi tupu ụbọchị ikpe.

outcome.answer: E buliri ya elu n'eluigwe; e kwere nkwa na ọ ga-alọghachi

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
